title: Keto Dutch Pancakes
description: A low-carb take on traditional Dutch pancakes, made with almond flour and eggs.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, eggs, almond milk, melted butter, vanilla extract, sugar-free sweetener, and salt.
2. Add warm water and mix until smooth.
3. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
4. Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
6. Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
7. Serve warm with your favorite toppings, such as sugar-free syrup, fresh berries, or whipped cream.
8. Enjoy your delicious keto Dutch pancakes!
